family: Fixed-palette magical energy: casting, fire/ice explosions and breath, clouds, orbs and lightning

selection_basis.all: available sources, known consumers, spatial/interpolation not-started; no runtime palette/recoloring flagged; no current selection or canonical match to a selected effect
selection_basis.visual_review: 119 known unselected available-source assets decoded for native RGB contact-sheet comparison; retain broad magical energy family; exclude physical objects, insects and tentacles, dark-only effects, native shadows, runtime palettes, assets already selected as animations
selection_basis.size_policy: Largest practical broad cohort identified from this comparison; visual subgroups share a proposed spatial workflow, not one uniform alpha/timing contract

proposed_processing.spatial: SeedVR2 7B x4, preserve native palette RGB, source geometry/centres and all cycles/directions; NEAREST display
proposed_processing.temporal: Apollo target 30 FPS after native FPS and each owner playback profile are established; preserve native duration, distinct frames and loop/one-shot semantics
proposed_processing.alpha: Preserve source coverage; select alpha/premultiplication treatment by actual native render mode and owner. Lot64 Blended feather/premultiplication cannot be copied globally.

excluded_cases.SPARMOUR: Canonical source equals already accepted OHNVIS1; separate reuse/consumer contract, not a new generation
not_this_recipe: physical subjects, insect swarms and tentacles

preview_contract.pose: maximum total visible native RGB among used frames
preview_contract.render: native palette RGB over black; binary source transparency; cropped for reading, NEAREST resize per thumbnail
preview_contract.scale: thumbnail size does not represent ingame size
preview_contract.timing: static contact sheets do not claim runtime FPS
